spans.s:
mfn. (-ठः-ठा-ठं)
1 Hard, solid.
2 Hard-hearted, harsh, cruel.
3 Pale, yellowish-white.
4 Old, decayed, infirm. []
5 Bent, bowed down, drooping.
m. (-ठः)
Decrepitude.
E.
जॄ to become old or decayed, Uṇādi affix अठ, and the deriv. irr.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Old, infirm, decayed.
m. (-णः)
1

Cuminseed.
2

A plant yielding a pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.)
3 A sort of salt, (Bit-lobon or Bit-lavaṇa.)
4 Old age, becoming old and infirm.
n. (-णं)
Asafœtida.
E.
जॄ to become old, affix युच्.

n. (-णं)
1 Calcining or oxydizing metals.
2 A condiment, a digester.
E.
जॄ to decay, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Old, decayed.
E.
जॄ to be old, अण्डच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-रन्-रती-रत्)
1 Old, ancient, advanced in years.
2 Infirm, decayed.
m. (-रन्)
An old man.
f. (-ती)
An old woman.
E.
जॄ to be or become old, participial affix शतृ.

m. (-रुः)
A celebrated Muni or sage so named.
f. (-रुः)
The wife of JARATKĀRU, the snake goddess MANASĀ.
E.
जरत् being old, and कारु a maker; a practiser of austerities in old age.

f. (-या)
The goddess MANASĀ, exercising a peculiar power over serpents, as the sister of VĀSUKI, the Nāga.
E.
जरत्कारु as above, and प्रिया the beloved.

m. (-वः)
An old ox.
f. (-वी)
An old cow.
E.
जरत् old, गो a cow, affix टच्, fem. affix ङीष्.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A buffalo.
2 An old man.
E.
जृ to be or become old, Uṇādi affix झच्.

m. (-नः)
A man.
E.
जॄ to grow old, असानच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-रा)
1 Decrepitude, the general relaxation and debility consequent upon old age, or old age itself.
2 A tree, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.)
3 A female demon or Rākṣasī.
E.
जॄ to grow old, affixes अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-रः)
A paramour, a gallant.
f. (-री)
A drug, a medicament.
E.
जॄ to grow infirm, घञ् affix of agency, fem. ङीष्; weakening the affection of wives to their husbands, or diminishing the force of disease.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Infirm, decrepid, debilitated, old.
E.
जरा infirmity, and आतुर diseased, affected.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stooping, bent down with age or infirmity.
E.
जरा, and परिणत bent.

m. (-ष्टः)
A proper name: see जरासन्ध.
E.
जरा a female Rākṣasī, and पुष्ट fostered; assisted at his birth by a demon.

m. (-रुः)
Love or the deity KĀMA^1.
E.
जरा decrepitude, and भीरु formidable.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260619. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/268.

m. (-णिः)
The sovereign JARĀSANDHA.
E.
जरा the Rākṣasī, फिञ् affix of descent.

m. (-युः)
The womb, the uterus.
E.
जरा infirmity, इण् to obtain, Uṇādi affix उण्; also with a final स, जरायुस्. m. (-युः)

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Viviparous, born from the womb, as man and other animals.
E.
जरायु the womb, ज born.

m. (-न्धः)
A proper name, a celebrated king and warrior, sovereign of Magadha, father-in-law to KAṂSA, and foe to KṚṢṆA; he was slain in single combat by BHĪMA.
E.
जरा a female demon, and सन्ध connection, union; he was born in two halves, which were put together by the Rākṣasī JARĀ.

m. (-जित्)
BHĪMASENA, the third of the Pāṇḍu princes.
E.
जरासन्ध, and जित् conqueror: see the last.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Old, ancient.
2 Infirm, decayed.
m. (-री)
An old man.
E.
जॄ to become old, णिनि aff.

Flesh.
2

Skinniness, flesh flaccid with old age.
E.
ज to become old, उथन् Uṇādi aff.

r. 6th cl. (जर्चति)
1 To say, to speak.
2 To reprove, to abuse or blame.
3 To threaten.

r. 6th cl. (जर्च्छति)
To say, to blame: see जर्च.

r. 1st and 6th cls. (जर्जति)
1 To say.
2 To blame, to reprove.
3 To kill or hurt.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Old, infirm.
2 Split, broken.
3 Wounded, hurt.
4 Divided in parts or pieces.
5 Perforated.
m. (-रः)
1 INDRA'S banner or emblem.
2

Benzoin.
3

An aquatic plant, (Utricularia fasciculata.)
E.
जर्ज to hurt, and अर affix; or जॄ to grow old, affix अच्, the radical repeated, and the deriv. irr.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Ragged, perforated, full of holes.
2 Old, decayed.
E.
see the last, ईकन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wounded, disabled.
E.
जर्जर, and कृत made, च्चि inserted.

r. 6th cl. (जर्झति)
1 To say or speak.
2 To blame.
3 To threaten.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Old, decayed.
m. (-र्णः)
1 The moon.
2 A tree.
E.
जॄ to grow old, न Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.

m. (-लः)
Sesamum growing wild.
E.
जन to be produced, and तिल sesamum, deriv. irr.; also read जर्हिल.

m. (-र्त्तुः)
1 The vulva.
2 An elephant.
E.
जन to be born, तु Uṇādi affix, and र inserted.

m. (-लः)
Wild sesamum: see जर्त्तिल.

r. 6th cl. (जर्त्सति)
1 To say or speak.
2 To blame, to censure, to abuse.

mf. (-जः-जा)
An adulterine, the child of a woman by her gallant.
E.
जार as above, and ज born.

mf. (-तः-ता)
An adulterine.
E.
जार, and जात born; also with कन् added, जारजातक.

f. (-रा)
An adulteress.
E.
जार, and भरा who cherishes.

m. (-त्थः)
A sacrifice, thrice worshipping the sun in his southern declination.
